_source: Israeli VOR/DME stations. Idents, names and types from the IAA eAIP GEN 2.5 (List of Radio Navigation Aids). Coordinates for BGN, NAT, ROP, MZD, ZFR, BSA and RAM are the published antenna positions from eAIP ENR 4.1 (AIRAC 2024-10-31), converted from DMS — they replace the earlier OurAirports approximations, which sat 100-500 m off the CAAI CVFR chart and satellite imagery (ZFR ~104 m, NAT ~226 m, MZD ~162 m, RAM ~504 m). Reconciled with ENR 4.1: OVD (Ovda) removed — decommissioned, absent from the current AIP. LOT is now BET-MEIR DME, not Eilot: the facility moved and is DME-only, so it carries dmeOnly:true and no radial is derived from it (DME channel 57X pairs to 112.00 MHz, which is why the ident and frequency carried over from Eilot). Per-station type, channel, hours of operation, DME antenna elevation, coverage radius and remarks/limits are transcribed from the same ENR 4.1 table. NOTE: GEN 2.5 in the same AIRAC cycle still lists 'LOT | Eilot | VOR/DME' and is unchanged since at least 2022, so it appears stale; ENR 4.1 is treated as authoritative. Third-party aggregators (OurAirports, PilotNav) also still carry Eilot and Ovda — PilotNav even lists the Sde Dov NDB, an aerodrome closed in 2019 — so they are not reliable here. 'Teyman' on local charts refers to the Beer-Sheba (BSA) VOR at the Sde Teyman base.

vors.name: Metzada (Masada)
vors.remarks: Coverage limited to 30NM from facility. Not to be used between RDL015-RDL175 and RDL200-RDL330 except from RDL227-RDL247 where coverage limited to 10 NM from facility at MIN ALT of 4 000 QNH. Restriction: Authorized for use along ATS routes only

vors.name: Zofar
vors.remarks: Coverage limited to 30NM from facility. Reliable only along RDL009, RDL018 and RDL185

vors.name: Ramon
vors.remarks: The VOR/DME should not be used east side of the VOR/DME
